verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is that diagnostic settings let you route Entra activity logs to other endpoints for long-term retention, which gives some control over log retention. Lifecycle workflows manage users across their lifecycle, but the evidence never says they delete user data. Missing for 10: documented control over retention periods, user or data deletion and purge capabilities, deletion of personal data in response to user requests (data-subject requests), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
